title: Overly open CORS (nginx) — review required
description: Cross-origin sharing in nginx is opened wide: add_headers+Access-Control-Allow-Origins+["']?*. Any site can then read responses with the victim's ambient credentials where credentials are allowed, or probe APIs otherwise. This lexical rule flags the opening; the reviewer confirms the scope or narrows it.
remediation: List exact trusted origins (a mapped origin variable) and avoid credentials with wildcards.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches open CORS regardless of credential settings. Framework allow_origins forms are separate rules.
